sql: select r.status as run_status, r.passed, r.failed, x.scenario_key, x.status, x.turns, round(x.cost_usd::numeric,4) as usd, (select string_agg((c->>'id') || '=' || coalesce(c->>'ok','null') || case when (c->>'ok') = 'false' then ' {' || left(c->>'note', 220) || '}' else '' end, ' | ') from jsonb_array_elements(x.checks) c where (c->>'ok') = 'false') as falhas, x.error from public.ai_sim_results x join public.ai_sim_runs r on r.id = x.run_id where x.run_id = (select id from public.ai_sim_runs order by created_at desc limit 1) order by x.status, x.scenario_key
